note: Machine-readable index only. Each entry points at the real source of truth (a BUILD_REPORT.md or equivalent) rather than restating it -- this file is not authoritative over the code or tests it describes, and should be re-derived, not hand-edited stale, if a subsystem changes.
engagement_path: See COOPERATION.md and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bring_a_bottleneck.yml -- identical for every capability below.

capabilities.problem_class: Deterministic YAML artifact validation with structured, never-bare-boolean rejection reasons.
capabilities.inputs: A YAML artifact plus its declared schema.
capabilities.outputs: A structured validation result: pass, or a specific, inspectable rejection reason.

capabilities.problem_class: Epistemic Firewall -- keeps narrative/persuasion/repetition from acquiring runtime authority; append-only quarantine and dissent records.
capabilities.inputs: A candidate artifact or claim to admit, quarantine, or reject.
capabilities.outputs: A gate decision plus, if disputed, a preserved dissent record.
capabilities.limitations: Single-reviewer release (no N-of-M requirement); reviewed_by is unauthenticated free text -- see docs/LIMITATIONS.md items 1-2.
capabilities.authority_required: A named reviewed_by to release a quarantined artifact.

capabilities.problem_class: Knowledge Production Machine -- immutable source registry, 15-value epistemic classification with forbidden-transition enforcement, promotion state machine.
capabilities.inputs: Raw source content (text/bytes) plus provenance metadata; a claim to classify.
capabilities.outputs: A content-addressed SourceRecord; a classified Claim with confidence and frozen, append-only history.
capabilities.authority_required: Promotion requires a reviewer distinct from the producer (SelfPromotionForbidden) -- the producer can never self-certify.

capabilities.problem_class: Modular Architecture Generation Library -- composable capability modules with explicit read/write/execute jurisdiction; a composition engine that refuses conflicting combinations with a full explanation.
capabilities.inputs: Capability module descriptors declaring their own jurisdiction.
capabilities.outputs: A composition decision (admit or refuse), with the conflicting jurisdiction named on refusal.
capabilities.authority_required: None beyond normal code review; see magl/BUILD_REPORT.md for any module-specific gate.

capabilities.problem_class: Legacy Architecture Upgrade Library -- maps an existing organisation's systems, proposes bounded automation, requires human review before any pilot deploys.
capabilities.inputs: A description of an existing system, its bottlenecks, and a candidate automation.
capabilities.outputs: A bounded automation proposal, blocked from pilot deployment until explicitly reviewed.
capabilities.authority_required: Explicit human review via rpa/gates/human_jurisdiction.py before any pilot may deploy.

capabilities.problem_class: Adversarial Archetype Library -- defensive threat taxonomy where symbolic/narrative classification is structurally prevented from becoming technical evidence; a 12-question permission root gate.
capabilities.inputs: A candidate threat classification or permission request.
capabilities.outputs: A verdict: AUTHORIZED_WITH_CONSTRAINTS, REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW, or REFUSED, with the deciding question named.
capabilities.limitations: Two named judgment calls (unevidenced-authority-claim and contradictory-evidence handling) are open in HUMAN_DECISIONS.md item 5.
capabilities.authority_required: taal/gate/root_gate.py's 12-question gate; human review on ambiguous verdicts.

capabilities.problem_class: Shared infrastructure: panic-detection circuit breaker (information velocity vs. verification velocity), reality-yield ledger, publication/communication/admission gates, repository health sensor, capability index.
capabilities.inputs: Varies by module -- e.g. a velocity signal, a value claim, a publication/communication request, or current repository state.
capabilities.outputs: Varies by module -- e.g. a throttle recommendation, a yield/cost ledger entry, a fail-closed switch decision, a bounded finding.
capabilities.authority_required: publication_gate.py and communication_gate.py both default closed and require a named human authorization to open.

capabilities.problem_class: A finite, typed, scoped, budgeted, expiring, revocable authority object (ReleaseCode) with a durable, crash-hardened, replay-on-restart ledger and fail-closed, two-point-enforced evaluation -- the primitive a persistent tick loop needs to act without a human re-asked every time, without ever inheriting unlimited trust.
capabilities.inputs: A capability name, target, and an issued ReleaseCode (release_id, allowed_capabilities, allowed_targets, budget, expiry).
capabilities.outputs: An ADMIT/DENY/ERROR decision, a durable ActionRecord, and a tick receipt (foundation/authority_runtime_tick_log.jsonl, machine-local, gitignored).
capabilities.limitations: As of commit 6b181de: no ReleaseCode has ever been issued against the real default ledger, nothing is installed to cron, and the only defined authority class (ZERO_SPEND_READ_ONLY, capability RUN_PULSE_SWEEP) has no spend or external-effect authority. authority_pulse.py (the cron-shaped entry point) is proven as a real subprocess but is not wired into any scheduler.
capabilities.authority_required: issue_release() is the only way authority is created; no expand/renew/increase_budget path exists on the public surface (checked by test). Installing a real trigger or issuing a real release are each separate, not-yet-authorized decisions.
capabilities.evidence: foundation/authority_sigil.py, foundation/authority_runtime.py, foundation/authority_pulse.py, foundation/tests/test_authority_sigil.py, foundation/tests/test_authority_runtime.py, foundation/tests/test_authority_pulse.py (42/42 passing)

capabilities.problem_class: Akashic Narrative Engine -- consolidates raw input into inspectable, provenance-preserving atoms with an epistemic layer and falsification criteria; preserves contradictions rather than forcing resolution.
capabilities.inputs: Raw human/text input as a narrative-atom candidate.
capabilities.outputs: A classified narrative atom (RAW to OBSERVED/CLASSIFIED) with related-atom and contradiction checks.
capabilities.authority_required: None beyond normal code review; see narrative/BUILD_REPORT.md for classification-specific detail.

capabilities.problem_class: Safe two-track classifier for a large external legacy YAML corpus (conformant vs. non-conformant), built for one specific standing decision rather than as general infrastructure.
capabilities.limitations: 106 permission-denied files and 2,952 non-conformant files await a human triage decision -- see HUMAN_DECISIONS.md item 3. No BUILD_REPORT.md for this subsystem; see legacy/DECISION_PACKET.md instead.
capabilities.authority_required: A pending human decision on whether to re-scan or triage the unresolved files -- see HUMAN_DECISIONS.md item 3.
